recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If BRR wants a new derived product-level search parameter that traverses incoming Ingredient.for links without using _has, that should be raised as a fresh search semantics request rather than treated as an unapplied FHIR-28174 fix.
issue_request: FHIR-28174 was a Published/Persuasive BRR request approved for R5 to allow medicinal products to be searched by ingredient, Ingredient resources to be searched by substance or substance definition, the old substance code search to be renamed to substance-code, and AdministrableProductDefinition to expose related device and manufactured-item links.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-28174, but the R5 medication-definition resource additions introduced the relevant search-parameter bundles. The product ingredient search parameters were initially reference searches while product resources pointed at Ingredient, and the Ingredient substance, substance-code, and substance-definition search parameters are present.
additional_context: FHIR-31808 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification and intentionally reversed the linkage direction so Ingredient points back to MedicinalProductDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, and ManufacturedItemDefinition through Ingredient.for. Commit fbfbf287b1 added Ingredient.for and changed product ingredient elements/search parameters from reference-to-Ingredient to CodeableConcept/token fallback ingredients. Current source and v5.0.0 share that model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing product-level ingredient reference search parameters would conflict with the later approved Ingredient.for model; the current source retains Ingredient substance/substance-code/substance-definition searches, Ingredient.for for reverse searches, direct product ingredient token searches for coded fallback ingredients, and AdministrableProductDefinition device/manufactured-item references.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that reversed product-to-Ingredient references into Ingredient.for and superseded the literal product reference-search shape requested by FHIR-28174.
